title: Fixings from rules: a bracket screwed on, and the coupon that measures it
summary: @rulecad/fixings in designs (v.fixings) and fasten in assemblies: each screw followed along its axis for its holes, its far end, its length, its thread, its seat, its key and its load. A shelf bracket with a pilot, an insert boss and nuts in slots, and the fixings coupon to print; measurements to come
